description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to HTTP/WebSocket request handling within the WPEFramework Web namespace. It includes request parsing, serialization, MIME type determination, and request metadata management.

classes.name: IBody
classes.description: Interface for request/response body serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with hash type and data.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents authorization credentials with type and token.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/WebSocket request with methods for parsing, serialization, and management of request data.

methods.name: MIMETypeForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type for a given file path.
